annotations.title: Remove a company from my watchlist

description: Remove a company from the user's watchlist. Requires the user's confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

listing.description: The company: its FirmLedger slug (best — returned by search_listings), its exact name, its FirmLedger ID such as "FL-00012", or its FirmLedger profile URL.
